title: API
description: API for Paper and Folia to make it easier to write plugins
body:
### API

A library for simplifying writing plugins for Paper and Folia


## Features of API
- Ability to create .yml configuration files faster
- Ability to create language .json files
And other minor functions


This plugin is required for the following plugins to work.
- [Economy](https://modrinth.com/project/laimcraft_economy)




This API is not recommended for plugin development, but I wrote it and it will be needed for my plugins.
There is no documentation for this API and it is intended solely to enable some plugins written by me to work.
